'''Matthew Lafontaine''' (also published as '''Matt LeFontane''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[2000 Nevada State Championship]] on 8 April 2000, according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d487">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-nevada-states-directors-viewd487/ nevada-states-directors-view], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-nevada-states-directors-viewd487/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Matt LeFontane he played at [[June 2000 Las Vegas tournament (30 June)]] on 30 June 2000 with EBO X-wings, according to Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d956">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ vegas-noise-factor-6-30], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 1 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
